# Bosch BMI08x SensorAPI

Vendored from the official Bosch Sensortec repository:

- Repository: https://github.com/boschsensortec/BMI08x_SensorAPI
- Commit: `c1ed227e7bb7da1fa600bbd4e5c82d0da1eb416a`
- Driver header version: v1.9.0 (2024-07-29)
